card.name: Final piece of drug names
card.fires_on: The last piece of a drug name that has been split into parts, such as -ilate, -ram, -il, -ine, or a salt word like sodium. It appears when the generic name is repeated in label text.

modes.label: Ending of a split drug name
modes.description: The closing piece of a generic drug name written in the running text of a label.
modes.example: Dabigatran etex<<ilate>> capsules can be used in pediatric patients aged

modes.label: Salt word after drug name
modes.description: The word sodium after the drug name, or a symbol such as ≥ in a lab-value threshold.
modes.example: For allergic rhinitis, montelukast<< sodium>> should be taken once daily.

card.writes: The suppressed tokens are all forms of "bug", so the output effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the last piece of a drug name once the model has already read most of the name.
